window.title: Total Editor
window.warning: RACE BONUSES ARE GLOBAL AND SHARED. Editing them changes EVERY character of that race in the world -- your squad, town guards and bandits alike. Bonuses are MULTIPLIERS (x1.15), not added points. The panel on the right edits one character's own skills (0-200).

help.overview: Left is the race being copied FROM and everything it carries; right is the race being changed and the bonuses it has now. Press copy and the target ends up with the source's values.
help.bonuses: A bonus is a MULTIPLIER the engine applies to a skill: 1.15 means fifteen percent more, 1.0 means unchanged. This page changes one skill at a time on the race selected in Race overview.
help.parts: Health is how much damage a part takes before it is crippled; hit weight is relative, so raising one part lowers every other part's share. Saving also pushes the new values onto the selected character, which heals that part -- the engine would otherwise keep healing it to the old maximum.
help.flags: Every box reads as a permission: ticked means the race CAN do it. The engine stores some of these the other way round -- its field is called 'no hats' -- and the window flips them so a tick never has to be read backwards. Untick 'can wear hats' and that race stops equipping helmets.
help.character: This page edits the character selected in the world, not their race. The sheet on the right lists every skill with its value -- click one to load it into the controls. Skills live in your save, so changes stay with that person.
help.uniform: Live preview of uniform armour colours and character portrait. Adjust colours or open the portrait camera editor. Changes to colours are live and only saved when you click Save.
